warning: Surface temperature anchored to an observed Landsat LST scene; the geometry terms (land class, sky view, shade, wind shelter) shift cells away from the site mean as deviations in degrees C. Screening output, not a meteorological forecast.

assumptions.note: Air temperature is estimated as surface minus 12 C, the observed LST-air gap for this scene type. No evapotranspiration model, so temperature never moves rainfall or runoff.

landClassProvenance: ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2021), CC BY 4.0, tiles ['N21E111'], resampled to 5 m by nearest neighbour. See data/landcover_hsk.json for the ESA->ours class mapping.
